main.description: Mark the current focus notification as read and return the next one. Ends focus mode and returns no item when the queue is exhausted.

currentId.description: ID of the notification just addressed, to be marked read.

issueAt.description: AT-URI of the issue to navigate to, if the item is an issue.

notificationId.description: ID of the next notification to address. Absent when focus mode has ended.

pullAt.description: AT-URI of the pull to navigate to, if the item is a pull.

repoDid.description: DID of the repository the next item belongs to. Absent when focus mode has ended.
